message.content:
**Key Signature:**  
C♯ Major contains **seven sharps**:

| Sharp | Notes affected |
|-------|----------------|
| F♯   | F‑notes       |
| C♯   | C‑notes       |
| G♯   | G‑notes       |
| D♯   | D‑notes       |
| A♯   | A‑notes       |
| E♯   | E‑notes       |
| B♯   | B‑notes       |

These sharps appear on all corresponding pitches throughout the piece unless otherwise indicated by accidentals.
